title: Pure-Lua MongoDB driver
principles: MongoDB specifications are normative and pinned PyMongo is a behavioral reference.
Driver, BSON, wire, SDAM, CMAP, and selection logic are Lua and never wrap libmongoc.
Each implementation activity observes a failing test before implementation and records passing verification.
Operational failures return nil and a structured error; programmer misuse may raise.
Every unified test case is runnable or explicitly deferred with a reason and a real roadmap owner; unknown capabilities fail.
Each activity enables every newly applicable upstream test case in the same commit; schema and inventory success never count as fixture execution.

milestones.goal: A validated, executable roadmap and pinned references.
